reconstruction.scope: Specific Ernst-Happel-Stadion: exact mapped oval roof envelope/opening, closed shallow white annular roof/radial underside beams, white outer collar truss/open inner catwalk, exposed concrete perimeter columns/floor belts, pale green windowed frontage, three covered blue/yellow seating tiers/concourse aisles, blue representative athletics track and football pitch/goals, two supported neutral end boards. Four existing shared concrete/paint/window-grid/canvas graphs. No roof over pitch, unique atlas/copied text/live screens, crowd/event fixtures, furnished offices, neighboring practice ground/railway or whole-site slab.
